from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

# Values derived from the task's provided cause list
CauseCategory = Literal[
    "非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿",
    "婚姻家庭纠纷",
    "行政主体 - 司法行政管理（司法行政）",
    "渎职罪",
    "行政行为 - 行政征收",
    "行政行为 - 行政监督",
    "行政行为 - 行政裁决",
    "民事案由 - 合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷",
    "破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪",
    "知识产权与竞争",
    "行政行为 - 行政合同",
    "用益物权纠纷",
    "继承纠纷"
]

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """One document instance mapped to a cause category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the court document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    matched_cause: CauseCategory = Field(description="The specific cause of action this document belongs to, selected from the provided task list")
    key_finding: str = Field(description="Short excerpt or fact from the text that justifies this cause mapping")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase] = Field(description="List of all parsed documents with their matched cause categories")
